lines.say: Expectation: two hours of biology. Reality: colour-coding the timetable.
Expectation: phone in another room. Reality: phone under the textbook.
Expectation: start at four. Reality: start at nine, panicking.
The fix isn't willpower. It's a plan that moves when reality happens.
Offload builds that plan from your exam dates, and tests you as you go.
You just click the link in your calendar and show up.
